text: and wishing that maybe I could be one of them. Are you worried? The sun, it sets, it's not indifferent to me. Just turn on her and set on her too. Do you stare into the sky with nothing to do? Now we're going once a real blue clock is right, Pacific Standard Time. Stare into the sky with nothing to do.
